scope: Independent source/rate mathematical and final code review; no new hardware fit, source edits or commits by reviewer. CMake test target and Tests/ClassicSawFidelityTests.cpp added by reviewer.

test.harmonic_check: H2-H8 from4096 uniformly spaced waveform phases at1760Hz with referenceIncrement=(1760/rate)*(rate/44100), rates44100/48000/96000. Oracle is independent SciPy BSpline. This checks physical kernel duration; not sampled-host alias spectra or hardware validation.
test.mean_check: Piecewise four-point Gaussian integration split at every periodized half-sample spline knot; not a finite sampled-window mean.

diagnostic_timing.qualification: One scalar batch, not real-time/plugin capacity evidence

retained_failed_gate.qualification: Exact-double identity failed on a3.47e-18 difference. Retained followup covers140014 samples, max3.55e-15 and zero float-cast differences; no production adjustment to force double identity.

code_review.coefficients: All32 production literals are the frozen selected coefficients, verified by independent oracle/prototype checks. Mean is evaluated from their paired knot integrals once.
code_review.rate: Kernel coordinate and mean use nativeIncrement*(sampleRate/44100). At44100 the factor is exactly1. The engine native phase clock is unchanged. Non44100 hardware output remains unmeasured.
code_review.bounds: Finite position and increment guards precede integer conversion; positive referenceIncrement is capped at.45*(768000/44100), bounding periodic sum at63 terms. No allocation in source evaluator.
code_review.clock: Phase advance, natural wrap flag, fractional wrapOffset and existing phaseOffset precede the new value calculation unchanged.
code_review.sync: Final guard routes only OSC1 under MixModType::Sync to the existing naive-reset/polyBLEP Saw. OSC2 and ordinary Mix/Ring Saw continue W4. The flag is used only in the Saw branch; other waveforms are untouched.
code_review.sync_regression_context: The reset sample itself was preserved, but the first integration changed later samples because the wider W4 support ignores forced-reset history. An existing full-engine naive-sync waveform test caught this; the test was not relaxed. Final guarded code retains legacy synced OSC1 until there is evidence for its reset-history correction.
code_review.test_limits: Header source checks and phase-domain harmonic checks do not independently test full engine host-rate spectra. Complete raw12-case reproduction and the unchanged Sync regression test belong to root full-suite/replay receipts.
code_review.conclusion: No actionable blocker in the final guarded source. Retain public-reference uncertainty and evaluate later changes against actual rendered audio.

separate_complete_replay.scope: Reviewed final run-02 receipt after Sync fallback; replay and full artifact verification owned by benchmark_audit, not rerun here.
